source_title_original: Standard Superstructure Drawing for Road Bridges: RC Deck with Precast RC Beams (20.0 m and 25.0 m simply supported spans)
organisation: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport, Department of Roads, Bridge Branch
construction: Reinforced concrete (RC), precast in casting yard; NOT prestressed.
geometry_notes: Midspan outline transcribed from the 'SECTION OF PRECAST BEAM AT MID SPAN (TYP.)' view (Drg 5/10, PDF p7). The view is cut through an intermediate stiffener, so its rectangular 700-wide outline is the stiffener; the I outline inside it is the beam.
Splay horizontal 187.5 = (700-325)/2, printed as 187^5 in Drg 7/10 Detail 'Y' (PDF p9) of both volumes.
Note 4: 'Chamfer 12mm x 12mm shall be provided at all junctions of the formwork unless otherwise specified in the drawings.' No chamfer is drawn on any section.

CONVENTION (best estimate): 12 mm legs along both faces at the 6 salient corners formed by two formwork faces (2 soffit, 2 bottom-flange shoulders, 2 top-flange undersides). Top edges (free surface, roughened per Note 8) and 4 re-entrant web/splay junctions left sharp.

Chamfer area effect: removes 392.5 mm2 (soffit 2x72.0, shoulders 2x56.2, top undersides 2x68.0). Alternatives: also chamfering the 2 top edges removes a further 144.0 (total 536.5); 12x12 fills at the 4 re-entrant junctions would add 248.5. All alternatives are below 0.1% of area.
Intermediate stiffeners (700-wide, at cross girders) and 700x depth rectangular end blocks are excluded.
No published section properties; analytic checks only.
